explanation: Store complete words in a set. Search scans words of exactly the pattern length and compares each position, accepting a literal match or a dot wildcard. Matching requires the full pattern and word lengths to agree.
timeComplexity: O((L+1) log(U+1)) insertion upper bound with an ordered set; O(U(P+1)) worst-case search for U words and pattern length P.
spaceComplexity: O(S+U) stored strings/set entries; O(1) additional search workspace.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 C++ algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
